verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Full accounts receivable" as a service, and the evidence also mentions custom reporting and real-time account data in its portal. That points to AR being handled as a managed bookkeeping service, but nothing shows accountant-facing AR tracking tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of AR aging reports, per-customer balance views, a description of how AR is tracked or exposed in the portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AR functionality.
